Commentary.Commentary: The Zimbabwean bowlers acquitted themselves well, restricting the Indian batsmen and picking up wickets at crucial moments. Donal Tiripano was the most devastating of the lot, taking three wickets and giving the least runs. The fielding was also more lively and they did a good job saving the bigger shots, with a few exceptions. It remains to be seen how Zimbabwe will chase down the target or the approach that India will take to restrict them. Stay tuned for the chase.

That brings an end to the Indian batting innings. The visitors will be disappointed with their low-scoring total but Kedar Jadhav was successful in pushing up the score at crucial stages. Rahul got India off to a fine start but Mandeep was not able to get any traction and was soon dismissed by Tiripano. It was a slow start for India with the runs coming few and far between. Rayudu held the line until the arrival of Jadhav. Their 49-run partnership brought some much needed stability as India were in dire straits.Some hard-hitting by Jadhav and Patel in the death overs pushed India to a decent total of 138/6.
Full on off, Patel drills it down the ground towards long off and picks up another brace. 16 off the final over! INDIA END ON 148/6!

SIX! He's picked the bones out of that one! Full and in the slot, Patel is up for it as he plonks his front foot out and thumps it over long off for a biggie. There was a fielder there but he could do nothing about it. Can Patel finish well?
Full on off, driven flat batted down the ground towards long off. Patel once again comes back for the second. Madziva is really annoyed with that effort.

This is good running between the wicket! Full and wide outside off, Patel chips it neatly towards long off and calls two straightaway. Madziva yells Chamu Chamu but they manage to come back for the second.
Full on off, Patel lofts it over mid off for a brace.
Full on middle, Kulkarni flicks it towards the leg side for a single.
Wide! Short of a length delivery on middle, Kulkarni ducks to evade it. It was too high and the umpire rightly signals it a wide.
DHAWAL KULKARNI is the next batsman in. NEVILLE MADZIVA is in to bowl.

OUT! Jadhav's innings comes to an end! Slower short ball on middle, at 106.5 kph. Jadhav comes down the track to pull but the bounce gets bigger on him and as a result he gets a top edge. The ball squirts up towards long on where Chigumbura settles underneath that one. A superb knock from Kedar nevertheless. Tiripano ends his spell with figures of - 4-0-20-3!
FOUR! Easy pickings that! Strayed on the pads, Jadhav stays put inside the crease and flicks it towards fine leg for a boundary.

Full on off, Patel looks to swing his bat but gets an inside edge on the pads. The ball rolls towards the keeper and a single is taken. The keeper has a shy at the striker's end and he misses. There is no one backing up and they decide to take two overthrows.

Chance of a run out! Slower length delivery on middle,  Jadhav looks to pull but the ball hits him on the glove and dies down near the stumps. Axar wanted a single. There is a Yes... No... Yes... and eventually they decide to cross over. The keeper comes running in, collects the ball and has a shy at the other end. He misses and a single is completed.
Back of a length delivery on middle, Jadhav comes down the track and pulls it towards mid-wicket for a brace.
Full on off, pushed towards point for a single.
Maiden T20I fifty for Kedar Jadhav!
FOUR! Full down the leg side, Jadhav gets a glancing shot and the ball travels past third man for four runs.
FOUR! Full outside off, Jadhav square drives it to point and the ball races to the boundary line.
BEATEN! Yorker wide outside off, Jadhav swings for it but is beaten by the line.
Short outside off, punched to the off side for a single.
Full outside off, driven to the covers for a single.
SIX! Length ball on off, Jadhav comes down the track and slogs it over long on and the ball disappears into the stands. Looks like India are finally getting a break as Jadhav gets into the groove.
CHATARA into the bowling attack.

Did that carry? Angles a length delivery on middle, Jadhav comes a couple of steps ahead to pull but since he was cramped for room the ball goes off the inner part of the bat towards short fine leg where Madziva dives forward to take that one but the ball falls just short of him. To add to that, also a single is conceded. Madziva seems to have hurt his finger as well.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Fuller length ball on off, pushed towards covers.
Full on off, bunted back to Donald.
AXAR PATEL is the new man in!

OUT! Bowled 'em! Ouch, Dhoni seems to have been hurt as the bails struck him on his right eye. Angles a length delivery on off, slower in pace as well. Dhoni swings his bat only to get an inside edge on to the stumps. Another big wicket and the Indians are really struggling at the moment. Hope the skipper is all fine.
Slower short ball on off, Dhoni comes down the track to pull but gets beaten by the lack of pace there.
Length ball outside off, Jadhav plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man.
The batsman gets an inside edge and the ball hits him on the pads.
Length ball outside off, Jadhav charges down the wicket and drives it though the covers for a brace.
Length ball wide down the leg side. The umpire signals a wide.
Jadhav seems to have been losing his composure. He dashed with the bowler and then was looking really tired after running two. He has called for an unofficial drinks break.
Jadhav flicks it to square leg and goes for two. Madziva stands in Jadhav's way and there is a minor collision but Jadhav makes it into the crease just in time.
Full on middle and off, driven through mid on for a single.
Length ball on middle and leg, worked to mid-wicket.
Full on middle, driven down to long on for a single.
Good length delivery, angled in on off. Dhoni looks to punch it through the off side but one gets beaten.
Fuller on middle, worked towards the leg side.
Angles a full length delivery on middle, clipped towards short mid-wicket.
On a length and outside off, Dhoni looks to defend but the ball stays low and he gets beaten up.
Good length delivery on off, dabbed towards third man for a single.
CHATARA IS BACK ON!
FOUR! Short of a length delivery outside off, Dhoni cuts it through backward point. The fielder seems to stop it but makes a mess at the boundary line and the umpire flutters his hand.
Full outside off, Dhoni pushes it to the cover region.
Full on off, pushed hard to extra cover but the ball is stopped by a good bit of fielding and only one run is taken.
Length ball outside off, Jadhav goes wide to cut it but misses the line completely.
Full on the pads, Dhoni flicks it to backward square leg for a single.
Length ball on middle and leg, the ball hits Jadhav on his thigh pad as he looks to flick it down the leg side. The batsmen run a single and the umpire signals a leg bye.
MADZIVA is back on!

Fuller on middle, Dhoni works it towards short mid-wicket and takes the fielder there on. There is a shy made at the bowler's end but it misses. There isn't anyone backing up and that allows MSD to take another one as well.
Skipper MS DHONI is the new batsman!

OUT! In the air... gone! Cremer strikes at the right time and sends Rayudu packing! Loopy ball around middle, Rayudu shimmies down the track, gets to the pitch of the ball and hits it down the ground towards long on. Chigumbura there gobbles it at chest height and just when the partnership was building, the skipper provided a breakthrough.
Jadhav comes down the track and drives it down to long on for a single.

Superb stop there! Flatter on middle, Jadhav gets down and sweeps it towards square leg for a brace. Kedar thought the ball would win the race but the fielder coming from deep backward square leg puts in a dive to save a couple for his side.
FOUR! Inside out over covers! Loopy ball around off, Jadhav springs down the track and lofts it cleanly over extra cover for a boundary.
Drifting on the pads, Jadhav gets down and sweeps it towards short fine leg.
Length ball on middle and leg,  Rayudu gets a bottom edge and the ball goes to the keeper.
Length ball on middle and off, Rayudu comes down the track but manages to get an inside edge to the leg side at the last moment and takes a single.
Defended off the front foot by Rayudu presenting the full face of the bat. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Short on off, a slower delivery from Chibhabha and Rayudu pulls it through long mid-wicket for four runs.
Shorter outside off, pulled to mid-wicket for a brace.
Length ball outside off, Rayudu looks to slash but the ball sticks and he gets beaten.
Full on middle, eased down to long on for a single.
Loopy ball around off, Rayudu comes down the track and drives it through covers. A superb stop allows them to pick up only a couple.
Full on middle, Rayudu bunts it back to Graeme.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.

FOUR! Sloppy work! Googly around off, Jadhav gets down and sweep it towards backward square leg. Tiripano gets across to his right but makes a very lazy attempt to stop the ball and as a result the ball crosses the ropes. Cremer isn't happy with that effort!
Loopy ball around middle, Jadhav looks to defend but gets an inside edge on the pads.
Length ball on off, punched to mid-wicket.
Good length delivery outside off, Rayudu defends it to the off side.
Good length outside off, defended with the full face of the bat.
Full outside off, played through mid-wicket for a couple.
DROPPED! Length on middle and off, Jadhav slashes it hard to Masakadza at cover-point. He looks to take a reverse cup catch but the ball bursts from his hand and the batsman run a single.
Full outside off, Rayudu it to long off for a single.
FOUR! Top edge but safe! Tossed up around middle, Jadhav gets down on one knee to sweep but gets a top edge which flies towards fine leg for a boundary. 10 from that over!
Rayudu comes down the track and drives it down to long off for a single.
On middle, worked away towards mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Late cut! Leg break outside off, turning away after pitching. Kedar camps back and deliberately cuts it behind point as the ball smears through the gap for a boundary.
Full and around off, Jadhav gets frustrated and gets down the track. He hits it hard towards covers where Sibanda makes a superb stop to save a boundary.
Loopy ball around off, Jadhav defends it towards the off side.
Fuller outside off, defended off the front foot to the off side and the batsmen get a single.
Length ball down the leg side, Jadhav looks to flick it but is not able to get bat on ball. An appeal goes up but the umpire doesn't think it made contact and signals a wide.
Length ball outside off, pushed to the covers for a single. The batsmen run hard and avoid the chance of a run out as the fielder hits the stumps.
Good length ball outside off, flicked to mid-wicket for a single.
Full on off, nudged to mid-wicket.
There is a slight delay as there is some issue with the sightscreen and Jadhav isn't happy.
Short on middle and off, Rayudu works it down square leg for a single.
Full on off, blocked down the pitch back to the bowler.
On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a brace.
Tossed up around off, Jadhav winds up for a big shot but in the end just pushes it towards covers.
Outside off, defended towards covers for no runs.
On middle and off, punched down to long on for one.
Loopy ball around off, pushed towards covers for a single.
Tossed up around off, Rayudu drives it through mid off for a single.
GRAEME CREMER to roll his arm now!
Fuller outside off, defended to the off side.
Jadhav has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Fuller on off, driven to mid on for a single.
Length ball outside off, left alone.
Good length ball, solidely defended down.
Length ball outside off, looks to drive it to extra cover but gets an outside edge and the ball travels to gully. The fielder dives to stop it but the batsmen get a single.
CHAMU CHIBHABHA comes into the attack.
Ambati chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump. Superb first over from Neville!
Good length delivery on off, Rayudu leaves it alone.
KEDAR JADHAV is the new man in.

OUT! Bull's eye! Pandey is out of here and Zimbabwe are on a roll here. Angles a length delivery on middle, Pandey gets forward and pushes it towards mid on. He sets off for a single but Chigumbura the man stationed there, collects the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end. He hits and they all go up in an appeal. Replays show Pandey is well short of his crease. A duck for Pandey and India in a spot of bother now.
A run out appeal is taken upstairs. It's a direct hit and Pandey is the man under question. The hosts are celebrating. Let's wait.
MANISH PANDEY is the next batsman in.

OUT! Rahul has chopped it on! Madziva strikes in his very first over and is off for a celebration! Tad full and around off, Rahul looks to give it a full swing of his bat and ends up getting a thick inside edge onto the stumps. Rahul is annoyed at himself as he walks back to the dressing room. Two down are India now!
FOUR! Lovely shot that! Fuller length delivery, shaping away a bit. Rahul makes room and drives it on the up past wide mid off for a boundary.
Starts with a short of a length delivery on middle, Rahul comes a step ahead and flat bats it straight to the man at mid on.
NEVILLE MADZIVA comes into the attack now!
Fuller on off, Rahul drives it through mid on for a single.
Played to the point region by the batsman for a single.
Short outside off, defended off the back foot to mid on for a single.
Pushed to the cover region by Rahul.
Fuller outside off, driven to the covers.
AMBATI RAYUDU is the new man in!

OUT! Caught! Length ball outside off, Mandeep looks for a big one, lofting it over the covers but does not quite get the ball airborne. Maruma takes a couple of steps to his left at extra cover and takes care to pouch it.
Angles a length delivery on middle, clipped towards mid-wicket for a single by Mandeep to keep strike.
Length ball on off, Rahul taps it towards covers for a quick single.
FOUR! Crackling cover drive! Tad full and in the channel outside off, Rahul lunges forward and absolutely drills it through covers. The ball goes blazing off the carpet towards the fence. Shot, KL!
SIX! Nailed it! Full outside off, Rahul lofts it over the bowler's head and the ball soars all the way over long on for a maximum.
FOUR! Full outside off, Rahul angles his bat and drives it hard through the covers for four runs. The bowler places his arms on his head in disappointment but there was nothing the fielders could do.
Short of a length ball, swinging in around off, defended from within the crease.
Back of a length delivery, defended towards covers.
Length delivery on the pads, Rahul whips it off the inner part of the bat towards the leg side for a single. He is off the mark after 8 deliveries!
Good length delivery on off, Rahul gets behind the line and defends it down.
On a length and around off, Singh looks to defend but gets an inside edge towards short fine leg for a quick single.
First runs on the board! Tad short and angled in by Donald. The ball slowly comes off the turf as Mandeep pulls it towards square leg for a brace to get off the mark.
Slighty full and around off, Mandeep pushes it towards covers.
DONALD TIRIPANO to bowl from the other end!
Full outside off, driven towards mid-off. That's a maiden to start off the innings!
Full outside off, Rahul looks to cut it but does not make contact.
Rahul flicks it to the leg side.
Full around off, driven through the covers.
Length ball outside off, Rahul aims to play the square cut but the ball dies and bounces low. He expects to make contact but the bat flies out of his hands.
Length ball outside off, Rahul cuts it to Maruma at point.
The players walk onto the field. KL RAHUL and MANDEEP SINGH get set to open the batting while TENDAI CHATARA starts off the bowling attack.
TEAM CHANGES - SIBANDA, CHATARA and MARUMA replaces Mutombodzi, Raza and Muzarabani for Zimbabwe.  India are unchanged from their last game.

Indian skipper, MS DHONI says they were looking to bat first today. Adds it won't get better in the second innings and feels the toss wasn't that important. On the wickets, says they are good. The last game had a variable bounce. On the team changes, he says they are playing with the same team.

Zimbabwean captain, GRAEME CREMER says that his side will bowl first as the pitch is similar throughout and that there is no real reason to change his decision. They will try to restrict the Indian batsmen and then go out and bat well. He concludes by saying that his side just need a good day, with some things going their way and that they would hopefully have a good one.
TOSS - Cremer spins the coin. Dhoni calls it incorrectly. ZIMBABWE WILL BOWL!

PITCH REPORT - Atul Wassan says the pitch is much harder with some cracks. Adds the ball will jag around as there are some dark spots. Further says it's going to be a high-scoring contest. Suggests team winning the toss should bat first.

This could be a historic series win for them, the first ever bilateral T20I series win of two or more matches. The visitors, on the other hand, will be eager to continue their winning momentum and end their tour of Zimbabwe on a positive note. Stay tuned for the all-important toss.

Hello and welcome to the final match of the T20I series between Zimbabwe and India. Each side has a win behind them and today's game will decide the outcome of the series. Despite their surprising win in the first T20I, underdogs Zimbabwe crumbled in the second match. Their performance was disappointing in each aspect and they will be looking to recover from it this time around and work around their injuries.
